ModSettings.HandleInjectedOverridesToolTip: If checked, the patcher will search for and merge in records that are injected. This can potentially make patching take longer.
ModSettings.MergeInToolTip:
If checked, all records needed by the mod will be merged into the output.
The output plugin will no longer depend on them as masters.
Only masters found within this mod's Mod Folders will be merged in.
Do not merge in records from plugins that are going to be kept in your load order.
